entries.zh: 尚且：尚且、甚至；连……都，何况（表让步递进）
entries.en: to do a little more or less; to do roughly, approximately, so-so
entries.notes: 西语 a poco más o menos（或多或少）与汉字‘尚且’贴合较松，存疑；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 尚简：崇尚简约；简省、从简
entries.en: to do a little more or less; to do roughly, approximately
entries.notes: 汉字‘尚简’与西语‘或多或少’对应不明，存疑；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 遽然：突然、骤然；急忙
entries.en: to do, or to set oneself to doing something without sin or offense
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:遽/濃]，闽南原稿音写合于‘遽’而不合‘濃’；西语 axarjarse 拼写难解；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 径自：径自、自作主张；擅自独行
entries.en: to do one's own will without that of the superior; to act on one's own initiative
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:涇/徑]，据西语‘不顾上意、自行其是’推为‘径自’；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 故意：有意、存心；任性依己意而行
entries.en: to do one's own will (against the superior's); deliberately, willfully

entries.zh: 俱能：全都会、都能；懂得怎么做
entries.en: to do; to know how to do (to be capable in every respect)

entries.zh: 快做成：赶快做完、迅速办成
entries.en: to do promptly and bring to completion; to finish the work quickly

entries.zh: 戕贼：戕害、残害；加害于人
entries.en: to do harm; to injure, maltreat
entries.notes: 第二字声调记号 T99（污损难辨）；戕贼与 hazer mal 对应明确；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 殃害：祸害、坑害；使人遭殃受害
entries.en: to do harm; to bring ruin or calamity upon

entries.zh: 照前：照旧、依照先前的样子；照样仿做
entries.en: to do in conformity with the model; to do as before

entries.zh: 迁就：迁就、顺应他人意愿；将就
entries.en: to do another's will; to accommodate, yield
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:迁/遷]，为繁简之辨，当读‘迁就’；西语 amor no poder 拼读存疑；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 作吊：吊丧、吊唁祭奠亡者；办理丧仪
entries.en: to hold funeral honors for the dead; to perform obsequies
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:作/仃]，据西语‘为亡者行丧仪哀荣’推为‘作吊’；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 再任：再度任职、复任；连任
entries.en: to do again, a second time; to serve another term, reappoint
entries.notes: 西语 otrauz 疑为 otra vez（再做一次）之缩写展开；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 作艺：以技艺谋生、做艺业；凭手艺自食其力
entries.en: to make a living by one's own craft; to acquire by oneself

entries.zh: 听从：听从、依从；听从而行
entries.en: to comply with his will; to obey
entries.notes: 西语 sto 可读作 Sto.（圣人）或 esto，缩写展开依赖推断；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 听命：听命、服从；奉命而行
entries.en: to do the will of the saint (Sto. = Santo); to take orders, obey
entries.notes: 西语 Sto. 为圣人缩写，展开依赖推断；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 听做：听从而做、依言而行
entries.en: to do as a lover does, lovingly, with affection
entries.notes: 西语‘如恋人般含情而做’与汉字‘听做’对应不明，存疑；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 挑难：挑起难题、出难题为难人
entries.en: to do it solely for gain; out of mere self-interest
entries.notes: 首字声调记号 T99（污损难辨）；汉字‘挑难’疑即‘刁难’，与西语‘只为利而做’贴合较松；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 起厝：起厝、盖房子；建造屋宅
entries.en: to build a house
entries.notes: 首字声调记号 T99（污损难辨）；起厝与 hazer casa 对应明确；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 非法：非法、不合法度；胡作非为
entries.en: to act disorderly, unlawfully (mte. = -mente)

entries.zh: 非为：胡作非为、为非作歹；不法行为
entries.en: to act disorderly, unlawfully; to do wrong

entries.zh: 非正路：不行正路、不走正道；行事邪僻
entries.en: to act disorderly; to stray from the right path
entries.notes: 末字声调记号 T99（污损难辨）；非正路与西语‘行事无序’对应清楚；官话栏空缺。
